changes.text: Explorer: a new file or folder may be a path, a/b/c.txt - the missing folders on the way are made
Explorer: dragging with Ctrl held copies - into the same folder as "a copy.txt"
Explorer: the active editor's file is revealed in the tree - folders expanded, selected, scrolled to
Git history: a commit's context menu copies its whole message or its hash
State: state.toml is replaced whole under a lock between windows, a broken tail dropped on reading
Terminal: a mouse selection starts where the button went down, not a cell aside where the drag was recognized
State: values of another version's state.toml are dropped one by one, the recent folders and tabs kept
Title rows: a long title runs under the buttons, veiled there, in every view - not into them in a narrow panel
GitLab view: merge requests and issues, the branch's last pipeline with run / cancel / retry, job logs in the editor
Cleanup by clippy: the terminal unlocked before laying out its text, UTF-8 checked once on opening a file
Git history: commits not pushed yet in a brighter color of their own - the dot, the subject and the arrow
Git history: the branch and tag labels before the commit's subject
Git history: the subject starts just past its own row's lanes, not the widest row's of the whole history
Git: the repository's name runs under the header's buttons, dimmed there, instead of into them in a narrow side bar
Editor: Ctrl+] / Ctrl+[ indent and outdent the cursor's line (the selected lines), as in VS Code

Git: the history as a graph, as VS Code's - lanes of branches and merges, the server's branch beside ours (its commits not pulled yet in a lane of their own), branch and tag labels at the commits, how the branch stands against the server's above the history

Editor: code folding as in VS Code - blocks by indentation and #region, Markdown sections, code blocks and lists; chevrons in the gutter, "..." after a folded line, Ctrl+Shift+[ / ], Ctrl+K Ctrl+L / [ / ] / 0 / J / 1-7; folds move with edits and are kept with the tabs

Editor: who last changed the cursor's line, faint after its text as GitLens shows it - author, age and commit message, the details on hover; git blame of the editor's text (unsaved too) in the background, off with git_blame = false

Status bar: a sync item next to the branch, as VS Code's - pull and push the incoming / outgoing commits counted on it, fetch when there are none, publish a branch the server has not got, a spinner while it runs
Terminal: Shift+Enter makes a new line - a pasted line break for programs with bracketed paste (Claude Code, through tmux too), Alt+Enter for the others

Editor: the active file's path relative to the open folder under the tabs, as VS Code's breadcrumbs - the first folders give way to "..." when long, the whole path outside the folder and in the tooltip
Find: lines with matches marked on the editor's scroll bar (right of the git change marks), the selected match brighter
Find widget: held by its right edge and kept inside the editor - its row came out wider than 440 and covered a terminal beside the editor
Status bar: the open folder's path is gone (it shows in the title bar and the explorer); a remote folder still shows in the remote indicator
About and readme: the app icon credited as "Icon by customicondesign_1 from Flaticon" with links to the icon, the author and Flaticon

Git: partial staging - Stage Change in the editor's change window stages just that hunk as the editor has it; in a git diff tab lines are selected (click, Shift+click, drag) and staged or unstaged with Stage Lines / Unstage Lines

Git: stash - the box button over Changes and the palette stash with a message typed in the palette (or with new files too); Stashes section with files and Apply / Pop / Drop, apply or pop the latest or a picked stash from the palette
Editor: lines changed against git's index marked in the gutter and on the scroll bar; a click on a mark shows the change under its lines with Revert Change, previous / next and Escape to close
Explorer: git colors - changed files in their status color with M / A / U / ! on the right, a dot on folders with changes inside, ignored files dimmed, the status in the tooltip
Recent folders: the cross on the selected or hovered row of Ctrl+R and Shift+Delete take a folder off the list, the list stays open
Editor: Alt+Shift+Down/Up copy the lines of every cursor down or up, as one undo step

Git: merge conflicts - blocks tinted in the editor with Accept Current / Incoming / Both on the first marker and for all blocks over the text, Compare; Merge Changes section (take a side whole, compare, mark resolved); Continue and Abort for a stopped merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert

Git: incoming commits seen before pushing - background fetch every 3 min (git_autofetch, no password or login windows), incoming on top of the history and outgoing marked, Sync Changes (pull --rebase --autostash, then push) and Publish Branch under Commit, a refused push offers to pull and push; a branch without upstream is compared with origin/<branch>
New window: Ctrl+Shift+N, File > New Window and the palette start an empty window offset from this one; the terminal leaves the key to the window
Update notice: "updated to X" shows once - the state is saved without it on the first frame, new windows do not show it again
Terminal: keys go to the terminal (tmux's Ctrl+B, the shell's Ctrl+W) but the window's few, the wheel and clicks to programs that asked for the mouse, arrows in full-screen ones
Remote: folders on SSH hosts - one ssh.exe channel per host, files, quick open, TODO, search and git on the host, ssh terminal, password window (SSH_ASKPASS), connecting in the background
One folder, one window: a folder open in another window brings that window to the front, a second start opens empty; windows merge what they save in state.toml
Markdown preview: in a tab (Ctrl+Shift+V) and beside the editor (Ctrl+K V), check boxes toggle the text, links open files or the browser, images from the folder; Open Preview in the explorer's menu
Title bar: menu names stand apart - 10 pt at the sides, a gap between them, a rounded highlight on hover and while open; backlog: Markdown preview
Updates: check at start and once a day, Help > Check for Updates, status bar item, download with checks and exe swap, restart now or on next start
Explorer watcher test: give the watch a moment before changing files (wine sets up subfolder watches late); backlog: menu bar spacing, Help > Check for Updates
Ctrl+R: keep 100 recent folders, show ten and scroll through the rest with the arrows, PageUp/PageDown, the wheel or by typing
Remote: open folders in WSL - files through \wsl.localhost, git and the terminal inside the distro, polling for changes, remote indicator in the status bar
Ctrl+H in a terminal below the editor maximizes the panel to the editor's height and back; a chevron in the panel header does the same
Ctrl+R picks a recent folder by name in the palette, the open one left out; in a terminal Ctrl+R stays the shell's
Side bar: hide view tabs from their context menu, a hidden view opened by a shortcut shows its tab while open
Terminal: Nerd Font icons fallback, Ctrl+click links, find in output (Ctrl+F)
Diff tab: changed chars within lines, sideways scroll, next/previous change
Diff tab: a solid, wider scroll bar beside the text that frames the part on screen
Ctrl+D finds whole words after selecting a word, Ctrl+F2 selects every occurrence, Alt+Up/Down moves the lines of all cursors
Hot exit: save tabs and unsaved texts while working, and per folder
Word wrap: continuation rows keep the line's indent, Home/End by screen row
Explorer: dim cut entries until pasted, show the folder under files dragged in from Windows
Add search and replace in the folder's files (Ctrl+Shift+F / Ctrl+Shift+H) and find in selection
Show problems of config.toml in the status bar
Cut the folder path in the status bar short instead of running over the right side
Add the TODO view and highlight TODO tags and Markdown check boxes
Fix the terminal font from config.toml not being applied
Terminal keys: Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+PageUp/Down switch terminals, Ctrl+W closes one after asking
Terminal font and size from config.toml (terminal_font, terminal_font_size)
Show the number of changed files on the source control tab
Mark the cursors and the changed lines on the vertical scroll bar
Open diffs from source control in the preview tab
Source control: a draggable line between the changes and the history
Fix the terminal panel growing a little with every repaint

Ask before losing changes when an edited file changes on disk
Add multiple cursors, Ctrl+D, moving lines, line comments, context menu, font zoom
Pick the encoding and line ending from the status bar
Restore editor tabs on start and keep unsaved changes on exit (hot exit)
